summary.intent: Migrate the cipher-box repository onto a new blueprint corpus (v2 documentation structure), bringing over CONTEXT.md and rewriting CLAUDE.md to drop stale v1-era content.
summary.outcome: Blueprint corpus and CONTEXT.md were copied in, CONTEXT.md's pointer line and cross-links were fixed, CLAUDE.md was fully rewritten to v2 (including removing a stale GSD reference), and the changes were committed as commit 4 following an earlier commit 3 that added 2,205 files.

repo: cipher-box's CLAUDE.md previously contained a GSD reference that is no longer applicable under the v2 blueprint structure and was removed.
CONTEXT.md uses a relative pointer line that broke when the blueprint corpus was relocated into the repo and had to be fixed post-copy.
workflow: When adopting a new doc corpus into an existing repo, check for stale cross-links/relative paths immediately after copying files rather than assuming they still resolve.

friction: CONTEXT.md's pointer line needed a follow-up fix after the initial copy, indicating the blueprint corpus wasn't a drop-in copy without adjustment.
